watches.name: GCC United

watches.name: D1 x AAPE: Green Camo Carbon
watches.description: Created in collaboration with AAPE, this limited-edition Polycarbon explores camouflage as part of the construction rather than a printed graphic. The green pattern flows continuously across the case, bezel, dial and integrated bracelet, creating a unified object where texture, color and form work together. Built from lightweight polycarbonate with a soft-touch finish, the watch balances technical comfort with bold visual impact. The result is a collectible design object that merges D1 Milano's industrial precision with AAPE's unmistakable graphic identity.

watches.name: D1 x Tetris™
watches.description: Created in collaboration with Tetris™ , this limited-edition watch reimagines one of gaming's most iconic visual languages through contemporary watch design. The stepped case echoes the geometry of 8-bit graphics, while the seven tetrominoes replace traditional hour markers, turning familiar game elements into functional design details. Finished in matte black with a soft-touch silicone strap, the restrained palette allows the pixel-inspired architecture of the watch to take center stage. Designed as a collectible object as much as a functional timepiece, it captures the precision, rhythm and simplicity that have defined Tetris for generations.

watches.name: D1 x AAPE: Green Camo Nylon
watches.description: Built on the Nylon platform, this limited-edition collaboration explores how translucent materials can change the way graphics are experienced. Rather than sitting on the surface, AAPE's signature camouflage appears beneath the clear nylon construction, creating a layered effect that gives the watch depth and visual movement from every angle. The integrated nylon case and bracelet keep the watch exceptionally lightweight, while the contrasting red seconds hand introduces a precise point of focus against the graphic green dial. The result is a collectible design object that combines contemporary material innovation with one of streetwear's most recognizable visual identities.

watches.name: Sapphire 2.0
watches.description: Built on the Polycarbon platform, this edition explores the relationship between visual lightness and material performance. The ultra-light grey polycarbonate case and integrated bracelet create a soft, understated foundation, while a bezel crafted entirely from sapphire crystal introduces a new material expression to the design. Typically used as a protective covering for the dial, sapphire crystal becomes a visible structural element here, framing the watch with exceptional clarity and precision. The matte grey dial reinforces the restrained character of the design, allowing the sapphire bezel to become the focal point of the watch.

watches.name: Poly Carbonium
watches.description: This edition explores the relationship between two advanced materials that prioritize performance through lightness. The matte black polycarbonate case and integrated bracelet provide the lightweight comfort that defines the Polycarbon platform, while a genuine carbon fiber dial introduces a more technical and expressive surface at the center of the watch. Unlike a conventional dial finish, carbon fiber reveals its layered construction through an irregular pattern created by thousands of carbon filaments embedded within a polymer matrix. This gives each dial a unique appearance while introducing additional depth and texture beneath the hands and indexes.

watches.name: Forest Camo
watches.description: Built on the Polycarbon platform, this edition explores the relationship between print and form. Inspired by fractal surfaces, organic overlaps, and irregular patterns found in nature, the camouflage design extends continuously across the case, bezel, dial, and integrated bracelet, transforming the watch into a single visual composition. Rather than replicating traditional camouflage, the print has been simplified and refined into a more contemporary expression. The monochromatic dial, applied indexes, and minimal handset preserve the clarity of the design, while the layered pattern introduces depth and variation across the surface. The result balances visual complexity with geometric precision, creating a watch defined as much by its print as its silhouette.
